messages.message:
Patch Set 2:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good, minor comments inline. I re-ran contrib/scripts/checkpatch.pl --file --fix-inplace against the parent versions of all 27 files and the result is byte-identical to this commit, so the change really is a faithful mechanical run with no functional change; every non-whitespace substitution (seq_printf -> seq_puts on literal-only strings, S_IRUGO|S_IWUSR -> 0644, __attribute__((__noinline__)) -> noinline, dropping the redundant = 0 initialisers, the compound-literal spacing) is behaviour-preserving. The remaining comments are places where the automated rewrite left the source a little worse than it found it and could use a hand pass before landing.
